note: Actual export shipments confirmed with dates, destinations, HS codes and B/L numbers (5 rows seen vs 1825 claimed by the counter; the free view shows only the latest 5, so the 1825 figure is the site's counter, not independently counted). Declared HS 640419/640420 does NOT match the observed records: every rendered export row is HS 64039120 (leather footwear covering the ankle, rubber/plastic/leather sole) — HS should be corrected to 640391/64039120 per Rule 3; this is not a rejection ground. Industry claim 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is wrong — the company is a footwear manufacturer/exporter (leather shoes for NEXT Retail UK, Berba Lederwaren NL, Zip & Friends DE). Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, annual-report splits) could not be retrieved: web_search backend returned 'Connection refused' on both attempts, and thecompanycheck.com, volza.com, eximpedia.app, trademo.com returned HTTP 403 and importgenius.com returned a JavaScript challenge. Domestic status therefore recorded as unknown, not as 'none_found' — absence of evidence here is a tooling limitation, not proof of no domestic supply. Revenue/export volume in value terms: null (not public on the free view). No CIN/PAN verified — null.
